title: 2026 Participant Guide — 130th Boston Marathon (PDF)
claims: The 130th Boston Marathon is scheduled for Monday, 20 April 2026.
All athletes will be across the starting line by 11:30 a.m.
The guide publishes Athletes' Village exit times by wave.
Buses from Boston drop runners at the Athletes' Village at Hopkinton Middle/High School.
Water, Gatorade and portable toilets are available at the Athletes' Village.
Athletes must show their bib to enter the Athletes' Village.
The start is a 0.7-mile walk from the Athletes' Village.
Participant parking is limited to the 52 and 80 South Street lots, and a bib is required for the participant shuttle.
Spectator parking is limited to Hopkinton State Park on race morning.
Post-race buses run from 12:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. from Columbus Avenue between Berkeley and Clarendon Streets.
Gatorade Endurance Formula and Poland Spring water are available to runners at every mile mark along the course and at the finish line.
Portable toilets are located at aid stations, and 26 medical stations are staffed along the course.
The B.A.A. asks athletes to complete the medical and emergency-contact information on the back of their bib.

claimVerification.note: 指南第 4 页赛程写 Monday, April 20, 2026；封面写 130th；不再声称指南出现 Patriots' Day。
第 4 页与第 10 页均写“All athletes will be across the starting line by 11:30 a.m.”。
第 10 页按 Wave 1–6 列出 corral loading 时间。
第 10 页：巴士把选手送到 Hopkinton Middle/High School 旁的 Athletes' Village。
第 10 页：Poland Spring Water、Gatorade、portable toilets 在 Village 提供。
第 10 页：进入 Village 须出示 bib number。
第 10 页：“The start is a 0.7-mile walk from the Athletes' Village.”
第 9 页：选手停车限 52 与 80 South Street，凭 bib 乘穿梭车。
第 9 页：观众停车在 Hopkinton State Park，赛晨有穿梭车。
第 9 页：免费赛后巴士 12:00–7:00 p.m.，从 Columbus Ave（Berkeley 与 Clarendon 之间）发车。
第 12 页赛道图黄色说明条给出同样的 every mile mark 与终点供应措辞。
第 12 页图面标“Portable toilets located at aid stations”，并有“26 medical stations will be located along the course staffed with a variety of medical professionals.”
第 4 页：要求选手在号码布背面填写 medical and emergency contact information。
